_comment: Tariffs where the RDW national parking register disagrees with the authority that actually sets the price. The register is authoritative for where a facility is and how big it is; it is not authoritative for what a municipality charges today. Every entry here was read on the source url on the date given. rdw_said records what we are overriding so the correction is auditable and so a future register refresh that happens to agree can be spotted.

overrides.note: Amsterdam P+R is a flat 24-hour tariff of 6.00 euro when you enter after 10:00, or 13.00 for the first 24 hours when you enter before 10:00, then 6.00 per 24 hours up to 96 hours. The reduced rate requires checking in and out on public transport with an OV-chipkaart or paper GVB card; OVpay, a bank card or a phone does not qualify. Public transport fares are separate. The register still carries the 1.00 euro rate the city charged years ago. The time-banded windows carry the same stale amounts: 1.00 for the after-10:00 bands and 8.00 for the 04:00-10:00 band, corrected here to 6.00 and 13.00.
